name: Troy Edgar
current_role: Deputy Secretary of Homeland Security (since March 2025)
summary: Troy Edgar, a former mayor of Los Alamitos, California, who was DHS’s chief financial officer in Trump’s first term, is the department’s second-ranking official, now under Secretary Markwayne Mullin.
